description: Update a plugin-level MCP server (by name, or id with `byId`) in place. Omitted fields keep their value; a given `args`, `env` or `headers` replaces the whole value, so include every entry to keep. Switching the transport drops the old transport's fields. Then regenerates the installed plugin locally, like `athenode init` without confirmation (the result adds `install` and `regeneration`, whose `pluginChanges` lists the tools whose plugin package or declaration was rewritten, with `suppressedIn` naming another tool's local settings file the plugin was switched off in; `missingEnvVars` is checked against the MCP server's environment, not your shell). If regeneration fails, the backend change is still saved and the tool returns an error. Requires an installed plugin (`npx @athenode/cli init`), unless `pluginId` names another plugin of the project: that one is changed on the server only, with no local regeneration.

args.description: New arguments (stdio); replaces the current list.

byId.description: `identifier` is a backend id, not a name (CLI: --by-id).

env.description: New environment variables (stdio); replaces the current map.

headers.description: New HTTP headers (http/sse); replaces the current map.

identifier.description: MCP server name, or its backend id with byId.

pluginId.description: Id of the plugin to act on (see plugins_list); the installed plugin if omitted (CLI: --plugin-id).

name: mcp_servers_update
title: Update MCP server
